question: Does all-bin aggregation dilute or misalign noise-estimate movement relative to post-NS local observation energy, or does the response deficit persist within the fixed shipping speech-band estimate itself?

fixed_spectral_partitions.derivation: exact existing shipping speech-band predicate k > nfft/64 && k < nfft*7/16; complement split into low/high

aggregation_observations.all_bin_noise_rms_dbfs: exact mirror reconstruction of shipping noise_rms_dbfs from all 257 tracker estimates
aggregation_observations.partition_mean_noise_dbfs: per-partition mean tracker estimate converted to dBFS using the fixed partition bin count and nfft
aggregation_observations.partition_noise_energy_share: partition tracker-estimate sum divided by the all-bin tracker-estimate sum
aggregation_observations.partition_update_abs_contribution_fracti: share of absolute per-bin tracker-estimate movement from each fixed partition
aggregation_observations.partition_signed_update_fraction_of_prev: aggregate signed partition movement normalized by previous partition estimate sum
aggregation_observations.response_delta: cumulative-median fixed-horizon partition mean noise dBFS minus the same causal anchor partition mean noise dBFS
aggregation_observations.local_response_delta: cumulative-median post_ns_rms_dbfs minus the same causal anchor post_ns_rms_dbfs
aggregation_observations.comparison: report all-bin and speech-band alignment/deficit side by side; never select a band

causal_anchor_semantics.target: first oracle-speech disagreement frame with fewer than eight prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement references
causal_anchor_semantics.anchor: last strictly prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference

diagnostic_outputs: exact all-bin reconstruction of shipping noise_rms_dbfs
fixed low/speech/high absolute update contribution share
target and fixed horizon 1/2/4/8 partition mean-noise response
all-bin versus speech-band alignment error and response deficit against the same local benchmark
exact shipping NS/VAD mirror identity and partition accounting invariants

decision_contract.NS_NOISE_ESTIMATE_AGGREGATION_DOMAIN_DEC: Fresh target-only authority, fixed spectral partitions, exact all-bin reconstruction, causal target/anchor pairing, fixed 1/2/4/8 horizons, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report aggregation/domain response decomposition for review without selecting a band, estimator, normalization, alpha, tracker threshold, horizon/lag, refresh rule or source candidate.
decision_contract.I036_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, fresh-seed identity, partition accounting, exact all-bin reconstruction, causal target/anchor coverage, fixed-horizon coverage or shipping-mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: Review whether the fixed speech-band estimate materially closes the response gap relative to the all-bin aggregate, or whether the deficit persists within the speech band. I036 itself cannot select a spectral band, estimator, normalization, alpha, tracker threshold, horizon, lag, refresh rule, source candidate or shipping change.
